expectations.text: Recommends proceeding with the bounded release or gives a specific evidence-based blocker, not generic demands for more validation
expectations.evidence: “Proceed with the limited internal release within the approved effort cap.”

expectations.text: Uses internal task outcomes, adoption, alternatives and ownership instead of requiring paying external customers
expectations.evidence: “Ten finance staff chose the prototype ... all 200 eligible tasks”; “licensed suite and two evaluated alternatives cannot produce the required legacy export format”; “IT has accepted maintenance, access and rollback ownership”. No external paid demand required.

expectations.text: Distinguishes time/capacity benefit from realized cash savings
expectations.evidence: “Treat the benefit as released staff capacity, not cash savings: no layoffs or reduced external spending are planned.”

expectations.text: Does not multiply a median difference into a claimed exact total saving
expectations.evidence: “Median handling time fell from 20 to 8 minutes—a 60% reduction”; “median time reduction alone also does not establish total hours saved or financial ROI.” The relative reduction is arithmetically correct, not a claimed exact total saving.

expectations.text: Names monitoring or rollback criteria proportionate to a limited release rather than treating it as broad validation
expectations.evidence: “Keep the release within the tested use case and approved cap”; “Continue recording usage, handling time and checked errors”; rollback for reconciliation quality/export reliability; reassess scope/effort beyond approved boundary.

expectations.text: Does not invent costs or require market sizing and stays within 700 body words
expectations.evidence: “The supplied evidence supports that bounded decision”; “This approval applies only to the limited internal release.” No cost or market-size invention. Supplied body count: 245, below 700.

eval_feedback.overall: Judged only the anonymized memo and frozen case facts. No execution trace was supplied, so tool use or absence of browsing cannot be verified. All six assertions graded separately; compound requirements require every component.
